YOU BECOME WHAT YOU FEAR
NETHÉMEX FILMS PRESENTS A FILM BY PETER GADIOT. WRITTEN BY PETER GADIOT. STARRING SIMON ARMSTRONG & SHARON DRAIN. MUSIC BY HAIDER ALI MIR. PRODUCTION DESIGN BY MAX GREGORY. EDITED BY KYLE SANBORN. DIRECTOR OF PHOTOGRAPHY SIMON ROWLING. PRODUCED BY DAVID WADE. DIRECTED BY PETER GADIOT.
description: A solitary figure walks down a misty, muddy path surrounded by greenery, evoking a sense of isolation and foreboding.
